text: Gerdur said the dragon took her son, but he was hidden in the keep.
The blade that slew the last dragon priest now rests in the hands of a farmer who has never drawn it.
Took you long enough. I was starting to think you'd gone and got yourself eaten.
No one but the Thalmor would dare enter that ruin, and not even they return.
Had it not been for the boy's warning, the village would have burned while the Jarl slept.
She was not the woman he remembered, though the scar above her eye said otherwise.
